com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.metadata

Interface Tablet

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Comparable<Tablet>

    @Beta
public interface Tablet
extends Comparable<Tablet>
    Represents a tablet as described in tablets-routing-v1 protocol extension with some additional fields for ease of use.

    • Method Detail

      • getFirstToken

        long getFirstToken()
        Returns left endpoint of an interval. This interval is left-open, meaning the tablet does not own the token equal to the first token.
        Returns:
        long value representing first token.

      • getLastToken

        long getLastToken()
        Returns right endpoint of an interval. This interval is right-closed, which means that last token is owned by this tablet.
        Returns:
        long value representing last token.

      • getReplicaNodes

        Set<Node> getReplicaNodes()

      • getShardForNode

        int getShardForNode(Node node)
        Looks up the shard number for specific replica Node.
        Parameters:
        node - one of the replica nodes of this tablet.
        Returns:
        Shard number for the replica or -1 if no such Node found.
